cat > /workspace/stress.py <<'PY'
import json,time,subprocess,sys,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from main import transport

def check(r,label):
 raw=json.dumps(r,separators=(',',':')).encode()
 print(label,'bytes',len(raw),flush=True)
 st=time.monotonic()
 p=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 elapsed=time.monotonic()-st
 print(label,'elapsed',round(elapsed,3),'status',p.returncode,'out bytes',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:1000],flush=True)
 assert p.returncode==0
 out=json.loads(p.stdout);assert 'sessions' in out,out
 return out

q={'groups':[],'nodes':[],'tasks':[]}
s={'topology':['torus3d',7,'line'],'caps':[10**9]*343,'groups':[[64,10**12] for _ in range(8192)],'tasks':[[i%342,0,10**9,0,0] for i in range(100000)],'query':{'groups':[0,8191],'nodes':list(range(343)),'tasks':[0,99999]},'transactions':[]}
# N*(T+D+E)~108.84 million. workload permits 100k edits too.
s['transactions']=[{'revision':0,'edits':[['weight',i,10**9-1] for i in range(100000)],'query':s['query']},
 {'revision':0,'edits':[],'query':q},
 {'revision':0,'edits':[['cap',0,0]],'query':s['query']}]
# Initial group exceeds work if 100k x1e9 >64e12, make two groups with same source domain.
for i,task in enumerate(s['tasks']):task[1]=i%2
s['transactions'][0]['revision']=0
s['transactions'][1]['revision']=1
s['transactions'][2]['revision']=2
out=check({'version':2,'sessions':[s]},'large-torus')
assert out['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]['accepted']
assert out['sessions'][0]['transactions'][1]['accepted']
assert out['sessions'][0]['transactions'][2]['violations']==[1,0,0,0]

# Maximal task and transaction counts; repeated querying and rollback must be
# independent of all the untouched tasks.
s={'topology':['leaf-spine',2,1],'caps':[100000,100000,0],'groups':[[64,10**12] for _ in range(8192)],'tasks':[[0,0,1,0,1] for i in range(100000)],'query':q,'transactions':[]}
s['transactions']=[{'revision':0,'edits':[['weight',0,2]],'query':{'groups':[0,8191],'nodes':[i%3],'tasks':[0]}} for i in range(50000)]
out=check({'version':2,'sessions':[s]},'many-transactions')
assert all(o['violations']==[0,0,0,1] and not o['accepted'] and o['certificate']['totals']==[1,128,100000,100000] for o in out['sessions'][0]['transactions'])

# All distinct speculative pairs in a huge group, rejected; exactly restored.
s={'topology':['leaf-spine',2,1],'caps':[100000,100000,0],'groups':[[64,10**12]],'tasks':[[0,0,1,0,1] for i in range(100000)],'query':q,'transactions':[]}
s['transactions']=[{'revision':0,'edits':[['class',i,i+1] for i in range(100000)],'query':{'groups':[0],'nodes':[0],'tasks':[0,99999]}}]+[{'revision':0,'edits':[],'query':q}]+[{'revision':i+1,'edits':[],'query':{'groups':[0],'nodes':[],'tasks':[]}} for i in range(1000)]
out=check({'version':2,'sessions':[s]},'large-mixed-rejection')
assert out['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]['violations']==[0,1,0,100000]
assert all(o['accepted'] for o in out['sessions'][0]['transactions'][1:])
PY
cd /workspace && python3 -B stress.py
